ruleOverbreadthSummary.execution: Exact received-first refs include received-only; upstream role unchanged. High negative prevalence is a sanity signal, not proof of poor play or causal diagnosis
ruleOverbreadthSummary.noFollow: Confirmed same-Engagement membership does not prove LOS or trade opportunity; context
ruleOverbreadthSummary.lone: Direct-contact membership does not prove spatial isolation or wrong positioning; context
ruleOverbreadthSummary.teamflash: Exact raw effects do not prove negative flash quality; context; no severity heuristic introduced
ruleOverbreadthSummary.dedup: No teamplay window overlap merge; deterministic context priority and cap select distinct facts
